exercises.title: PE question 4: IString — f1 counts, f2 builds
exercises.problemHtml:
The shape of question 4 on most PRO192 PE papers. The interface IString and Main are given. Write MyString implements IString:

  • int f1(String str) — the number of words that contain at least one upper-case letter and at least one digit.
  • String f2(String str) — every word reversed, word order kept, exactly one space between words, no space at either end.

A word is a run of non-space characters; words may be separated by several spaces. A blank string gives 0 and "".

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change the given interface or Main.java — like the exam, they are the paper’s files.
  • Never print inside your methods: Main prints what they return.
  • Your class is in the default package, file name = class name.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Dạng câu 4 của phần lớn đề PE PRO192. Interface IString và Main cho sẵn. Viết MyString implements IString:

  • int f1(String str) — số từ chứa ít nhất một chữ hoa và ít nhất một chữ số.
  • String f2(String str) — đảo từng từ, giữ thứ tự từ, giữa các từ đúng một dấu cách, không dư dấu cách hai đầu.

Từ là một dãy ký tự không phải dấu cách; giữa các từ có thể có nhiều dấu cách. Chuỗi trống cho 0 và "".

Chạy máy chấm trên máy bạn

Website KHÔNG chấm bài này. Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code, giải nén, sửa code trong src/, rồi trong thư mục bài (thư mục chứa cham.mjs) chạy:

node cham.mjs

Giải nén ra một thư mục mang tên bài (gọi là <thư-mục>). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 4 ca (2 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai rồi cho điểm. In ALL CHECKS PASSED ⇒ quay lại đây bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải. node cham.mjs --case 2 --show in input và toàn bộ output của bạn cho ca 2.

Yêu cầu

  • Không sửa interface và Main.java đề cho — như phòng thi, đó là tệp của đề.
  • Không in gì trong các phương thức: Main in giá trị chúng trả về.
  • Lớp của bạn ở default package, tên tệp = tên lớp.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Both methods start with the same guard (null or blank) and the same tokenisation trim().split("\\s+"). f1 checks two independent conditions with two flags; f2 builds the result in one StringBuilder with the separator added before every word but the first.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Hai phương thức mở đầu bằng cùng một phép chặn (null hoặc trống) và cùng cách tách trim().split("\\s+"). f1 kiểm hai điều kiện độc lập bằng hai cờ; f2 dựng kết quả trong một StringBuilder, dấu cách thêm trước mọi từ trừ từ đầu.

mistakesJson.loi: Blank input: "   ".split("\\s+") returns [""] — one empty word — unless you trim and check isEmpty() first.|||Chuỗi trống: "   ".split("\\s+") trả [""] — một từ rỗng — nếu không trim và kiểm isEmpty() trước.
Reversing the whole sentence instead of each word: "world 8 Java Hello" read backwards.|||Đảo cả câu thay vì từng từ: ra "dlrow 8 avaJ olleH".

Printing extra text (a debug line, a different prompt, a missing space after ":") — the output is compared line by line, so one extra character fails the case.|||In thêm chữ (dòng gỡ lỗi, lời nhắc khác, thiếu dấu cách sau ":") — output so từng dòng, thừa một ký tự là trượt ca.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The longest word is a running maximum over split("\\s+") after trim(); the average keeps a sum and a count of digits that pass isDigit and the parity test, and the count = 0 case is handled before dividing.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Từ dài nhất là giá trị lớn nhất chạy dọc split("\\s+") sau trim(); trung bình giữ tổng và số đếm các chữ số qua isDigit và phép thử chẵn, trường hợp đếm = 0 được xử lý trước khi chia.

mistakesJson.loi: Forgetting that 0 is even ("ab2c45x08" averages 2, 4, 0, 8 = 3.50).|||Quên rằng 0 là số chẵn ("ab2c45x08" lấy trung bình 2, 4, 0, 8 = 3.50).
Integer division sum / count — 14 / 4 = 3, printed as 3.00.|||Chia nguyên sum / count — 14 / 4 = 3, in thành 3.00.

Testing (ch % 2 == 0) on the character itself: '0' is 48, so it happens to work for digits but also accepts letters like 'b' (98).|||Kiểm (ch % 2 == 0) trên chính ký tự: '0' là 48 nên tình cờ đúng với chữ số nhưng cũng nhận cả chữ cái như 'b' (98).

exercises.title: PE question 4: from a path to an extension and a new name
exercises.problemHtml:
PE10 question 4 type. Write MyFile implements IFile:

  • String f1(String path) — the extension of the file the path points to (text after the last dot of the file name).
  • String f2(String path) — "New_" + the file name in upper case (with its extension).

The path may use \ (Windows) or /. The file name is the text after the last separator; it is valid only when it contains a dot that is neither its first nor its last character. Both methods return "wrong format" for an invalid name.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change the given interface or Main.java — like the exam, they are the paper’s files.
  • Never print inside your methods: Main prints what they return.

exercises.title: The real PE1 question 4: acronym and binary by hand
exercises.problemHtml:
Write MyStringNumberTool implements IStringNumberTool:

  • String buildAcronym(String string) — split the string by single spaces; for every non-empty word whose first character is a letter A–Z or a–z, take that letter in upper case. "Java virtual machine" → "JVM"; words starting with a digit are skipped.
  • String decimalToBinary(int n) — the binary form of n ≥ 0 without Integer.toBinaryString: divide by 2 repeatedly, the remainders read backwards.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change the given interface or Main.java — like the exam, they are the paper’s files.
  • Never print inside your methods: Main prints what they return.
  • Your class is in the default package, file name = class name.
  • Integer.toBinaryString / Integer.toString(n, 2) are not allowed (the grader checks).

exercises.title: LAB211 input that never crashes: read, sort, binary search
exercises.problemHtml:
Every LAB211 program starts with input that survives anything the user types. Write static int readInt(String prompt, int min, int max): print the prompt, read a whole line, and keep asking until it is an integer in [min, max]. Wrong input prints exactly one of these lines and asks again:

  -> "abc" is not an integer, try again
  -> out of range [1, 10], try again

Then the program: read n (1..10), then a[0] … a[n-1] (−1000..1000), print the array, min/max/average, a sorted copy, read a value (−1000..1000) and binary-search it in the sorted copy:

Entered : [12, 5, 7, -3]
min = -3, max = 12, average = 5.25
Sorted  : [-3, 5, 7, 12]
7 found at index 2 of the sorted array

Not found: 8 not found (it would be inserted at index 3) — the insertion point that Arrays.binarySearch encodes as -(point) - 1.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Prompts: Number of elements (1..10): , a[i] = , Value to search: (no newline after them).
  • Read only with nextLine(); the program never crashes, whatever is typed.
  • Sort a copy (Arrays.copyOf) — "Entered" keeps the input order.
